input.title: Give the password field the accessible name "Password"
input.rationale: The visible <label>Password</label> on line 11 has no for attribute, and the input sits outside it, so the two aren't linked and the password field has no accessible name. I can only edit the flagged input, so this sets aria-label="Password" to match the visible label text. That gives screen readers the correct name, and voice-control users can say the visible word. A better source fix is to add for="su-pass" to the label on line 11. That links the label properly, and clicking the label then moves focus to the field. Once the label is linked, the aria-label can be removed. Please re-test with a screen reader. This doesn't confirm the page meets accessibility standards.
